bias_targets.methodology: Calculating 'Subset Diversity' to measure the proportion of individuals with specific gender characteristics in data subsets; using Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) to identify strong associations between gender identity terms and stereotypical concepts (e.g., 'woman' and 'smile').
Calculating 'Subset Diversity' to measure the proportion of individuals with specific racial characteristics in data subsets compared to the populations they are meant to reflect.
Using Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) to measure the strength of association between identity terms and other items in the dataset to detect toxic stereotypes.
